name: Suffolk University
educationLevels: Bachelors, Graduate Certificate, Masters, Pathway, PhD
description: Suffolk University is a world-class private university that proudly welcomes students from all over the world to our Boston campus. We offer a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and law degree programs that emphasize real-world learning experiences. Your education will go beyond the classroom with custom-built degree programs designed to lead to exciting careers. Apply now for direct entry to Suffolk University, offering a range of undergraduate and graduate degree programs with high quality teaching and industry partnerships from around the globe.
